senses.en: not much (used only in a negative)
damp, moist, still a little wet

records.text: ini xadu asikis naki a karaw

senses.en: My leg did not hurt much.

records.text: ini xadu saisiman atun, saisiman pinarisan talima ki ina

senses.zh: 母親不很疼愛阿敦，只疼她自己生的
senses.en: She did not love Atun, but loved her own child.
It is not very hot now.

senses.en: How many children do you have?
How much/many is that?/ How much does that cost?

records.text: isiw ka xaima rakihan (xaima rakihan isiw)?

senses.en: How many children do you have?
How many cigarettes are still there?

records.text: nisiw a xumak ka xaima saw?

senses.en: How many people are there in your family?
to join hands with each other

records.text: xinalidan nuang mata dini murazaw di daran

senses.en: The cow pulled past this place.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.317–318，xalit- 條下派生詞

records.text: kaidini ka, nahaza xaaxalid u rakihan a rima a saw

senses.zh: 在這裡有一個人牽著小孩的手
senses.en: There is a person holding a child's hand.

records.text: maapa'ay namisiw a rakihan, muxalit namisiw a rima

senses.zh: （她）要揹他的孩子時，牽她的手
senses.en: Before carrying her child, she took her hands.

records.text: muxalit rakihan a rima a saw

senses.en: The person who took the hands of the child.

records.text: atun muxalit aba a rima pikadun duila lia

senses.zh: 阿敦拉著父親的手，就出發了
senses.en: Atun took his father's hand and set out.
